question: Which of the following statements are correct? 1. The player obtained the 争先红 Gourd (葫芦) in Chapter 3. 2. The player obtained the 乾坤彩 Gourd (葫芦) upon clearing Chapter 6. 3. The player obtained the 宝莲玉 Gourd (葫芦) upon clearing Chapter 3. 4. In Chapter 4, the player upgraded the 药王 Gourd (葫芦) to the 药师 Gourd (葫芦).

rollouts.answer: None of the four statements are correct.

db_evidence.notes: Statement 1 (争先红, false) and statement 4 (药王->药师 upgrade real but not in chapter 4, false) are both correctly and consistently retrievable from episodes/topic_facts/event_chains text and every rollout gets them right, matching the reference's implicit falsity. Statement 2 (乾坤彩葫芦, true) is retrievable but the closest 1h/30sec episode caption around 79620-79650s misnames the item '乾坤紫葫芦' (an apparent OCR/vision-captioning color-character error, 紫 vs 彩) while the true item name and a large currency drop confirming a purchase are only visible in raw frames at 79625-79636s, just inside/adjacent to the given clue window -- text evidence actively contradicts the ground truth here. Statement 3 (宝莲玉葫芦, true) is retrievable in principle: the exact clue window 30539-30549s shows the buy screen with 47418 currency (sufficient for the 7200 price) and, by the end of the window, currency has dropped to 40276 with an item-acquired banner -- but the DB's object_states/topic_facts caption for the surrounding 30540-30570s bucket foregrounds a '材料不足' (insufficient materials) phrase that actually describes a later sub-event (toggling a different gourd/材料 combination) in the same bucket, so every rollout that read only the text (all 5) concluded the purchase failed, and even the one clip_qa call aimed at statement 3 (rollout 3) targeted the wrong, earlier interval (23070-23160s) instead of the true clue window.

root_causes: DB caption/topic_facts text for the 30539-30549s clue window (statement 3) foregrounds a '材料不足' warning that belongs to a different sub-event later in the same 30s bucket, burying the actual successful purchase that happens earlier in the same bucket -- a captioning-granularity error that misleads every rollout that relied on text alone.

DB caption text around the 79625-79635s clue window (statement 2) names the item '乾坤紫葫芦' instead of the ground-truth '乾坤彩葫芦' (a color-glyph captioning/OCR error), directly contradicting the reference and misleading rollouts 0-2 into rejecting a true statement on a name mismatch.

None of the 4 zero-scoring rollouts used clip_qa/visual sub-agent verification for statements 2 or 3 at all (rollouts 0,1,2), or when they did (rollout 3), they aimed clip_qa at a self-chosen nearby interval (23070-23160s, 79560-79622s) rather than the exact given clue interval (30539-30549s, 79625-79635s), so the visual check never reached the frames that actually disprove the text.

All 5 rollouts converge on an 'insufficient materials therefore not obtained' narrative for statement 3 without checking whether currency/inventory changed across the full clue window, i.e. they read a single negative-sounding phrase as conclusive rather than checking the currency counter before/after.
what_worked: All 5 rollouts correctly rejected statement 1 (争先红葫芦 obtained around 4710s, long before chapter 3) using episodes/topic_facts text search.

All 5 rollouts correctly rejected statement 4 (the 药王->药师 upgrade at 68722-68732s is real, per rollout 3's clip_qa, but occurs in the chapter 5 window, not chapter 4) using event_chains chapter-boundary queries.

Rollout 4 additionally queried episodes text right at the chapter-6 transition window (75540-75840s), which was close enough to the true clue interval to correctly conclude statement 2 despite the misleading item-name text elsewhere, earning partial credit.
transferable_lessons: For 'did the player obtain/purchase X' questions, do not stop at a single caption phrase like '材料不足' or 'browsing/previewing' -- pull the exact clue interval's frames (or a tightly-scoped clip_qa call on the EXACT given clue_interval, not a nearby self-chosen window) and check for a currency/counter change or an item-acquired banner across the whole window, since a 30s caption bucket can conflate a successful sub-event with a failed one.

When a caption's item name is off by one visually similar glyph (e.g. 紫 vs 彩) and it's the sole piece of evidence contradicting a plausible statement, escalate to a frame/clip_qa check on the exact clue window before concluding the statement is false -- text captions from this pipeline can contain single-character OCR-style errors.

When clip_qa is used, pass it the literal clue_interval / total_intervals bounds from the question, not a coarser or shifted interval picked from earlier text search hits; a few seconds' difference (e.g. sampling only up to 79622s instead of 79635s) can miss the exact frame that confirms or refutes the claim.

For hallucination-detection questions with multiple sub-statements, verify each sub-statement against its own dedicated evidence window rather than reusing an earlier, superficially-similar mention of the same item name found elsewhere in the timeline.

Whether the currency drop observed at 79630-79636s (166809->154809, a ~12000 delta against an 18000 listed price) reflects the exact 乾坤彩葫芦 purchase or a combination of purchases/other menu actions in that window; a tighter frame-by-frame check between 79625 and 79636 would pin this down more precisely.
